parameters.query:
with payload as (select $1::jsonb p),
imported as (
  select public.prepass_large_fleet_import_payload(p) receipt, p from payload
), logged as (
  insert into public.prepass_large_fleet_sync_runs(
    export_id, mode, segment_key, smart_list_id, window_start, window_end, state, provider_rows,
    qualified_rows, inserted_rows, updated_rows, excluded_rows, file_sha256, file_bytes, provider_status, completed_at
  )
  select (p->>'export_id')::uuid, 'snapshot', p->>'segment_key', (p->>'smart_list_id')::integer,
    (p->>'window_start')::timestamptz, (p->>'window_end')::timestamptz, 'completed', (p->>'provider_number_of_records')::integer,
    (receipt->>'qualified_rows')::integer, (receipt->>'upserted_rows')::integer,
    0, (receipt->>'excluded_rows')::integer, p->>'file_sha256', (p->>'file_bytes')::bigint,
    receipt || jsonb_build_object('segment_key', p->>'segment_key', 'smart_list_id', (p->>'smart_list_id')::integer), now()
  from imported
  on conflict (export_id) do update set state='completed', segment_key=excluded.segment_key,
    smart_list_id=excluded.smart_list_id, provider_rows=excluded.provider_rows,
    qualified_rows=excluded.qualified_rows, inserted_rows=excluded.inserted_rows,
    excluded_rows=excluded.excluded_rows, file_sha256=excluded.file_sha256, file_bytes=excluded.file_bytes,
    provider_status=excluded.provider_status, completed_at=now(), error_code=null, error_message=null
  returning export_id
)
select receipt as import_receipt from imported;
